data.name: ProbeIntro
data.value: On a test page opened in Safari on the iPhone, this checks that touches land 1:1 on the screen and that typed keys arrive, and measures scrolling and latency. Hold the iPhone upright and turn on Zoom (Accessibility).

data.name: TipFirewall
data.value: Creates a rule that accepts the test page's port from the same network (local subnet) only. Windows asks for permission (UAC).

data.name: TipTouchProbe
data.value: Sends taps at 9 points, a swipe and a pinch to the /touch page, and compares them with where they reached the page (about 15 seconds)

data.name: TipScrollProbe
data.value: Scrolls the /scroll page with the current wheel settings and measures how far and how it glides (about 1 minute)

data.name: TipKeysProbe
data.value: Types letters, symbols, Enter, arrows, Backspace and ⌘A / ⌘C / ⌘V into the box of the /keys page and checks what arrived (about 15 seconds). Tap the box first. The device's input must be English.

data.name: TipLatencyProbe
data.value: Presses the middle of the /latency page 10 times and measures how long the mirror window takes to turn white (about 20 seconds). Keep the mirror window uncovered.
